Scanning Glacius. Beware its frost nova, the ice lances from its orbs, and absolute zero when its rings spin up.
Scanning Ignis. Beware the solar flare from its horns, the magma rain, and the inferno when its core blazes.
Scanning Solara. Beware the radiant lance, the halo burst, and judgement when its pillar of light surges.
Scanning Voltaris. Beware chain lightning, the ion storm that strips our shields, and the thunderclap of its crescents.
Scanning Verdanth. Beware the thorn volley, the spore bloom, and the overgrowth when its beam surges.
Scanning the Pentarch. Beware the convergence beam, the elemental storm, and the cataclysm when its heart detonates. Every Elemental we slew is missing from it.

Commander, this is Glacius, the ice Elemental. It has frozen every world around it, and in a day it will join the others at the Void. Bring it down before the fusion, and the Pentarch is weaker for it.
Commander, this is Ignis, the fire Elemental. The worlds around it are burning, and in a day it will join the others at the Void. Bring it down before the fusion, and the Pentarch is weaker for it.
Commander, this is Solara, the light Elemental. Its pillar of light is gilding every world around it, and in a day it will join the others at the Void. Bring it down before the fusion.
Commander, this is Voltaris, the storm Elemental. Its lightning is tearing at every world around it, and in a day it will join the others at the Void. Bring it down before the fusion.
Commander, this is Verdanth, the nature Elemental. It is overgrowing every world around it, and in a day it will join the others at the Void. Bring it down before the fusion.

Commander, this is the Pentarch, every surviving Elemental fused into one, tearing at the black hole at the centre of the galaxy. It is the greatest threat we have faced. Rally every fleet and every ally.
Commander, the Elementals have torn through the Void! Glacius, Ignis, Solara, Voltaris and Verdanth are loose in the galaxy. In a day they will fuse. Strike them down before they do.
Commander, the Elementals are converging on the Void! The survivors have fused into the Pentarch, and it is tearing at the black hole. Rally every fleet.
Commander, Glacius is under attack right now! Watch it live.
Commander, Ignis is under attack right now! Watch it live.
Commander, Solara is under attack right now! Watch it live.
Commander, Voltaris is under attack right now! Watch it live.
Commander, Verdanth is under attack right now! Watch it live.
Commander, the Pentarch is under attack right now! Watch the battle live.
Commander, Glacius is shattered! It won't join the fusion.
Commander, Ignis is extinguished! It won't join the fusion.
Commander, Solara has gone dark! It won't join the fusion.
Commander, Voltaris is grounded! It won't join the fusion.
Commander, Verdanth has withered! It won't join the fusion.
Commander, the Pentarch has fallen! The Void is saved, and everyone who fought it can claim the spoils.

Every other Wednesday at eighteen hundred UTC, five Elementals tear through the Void for forty-eight hours. For the first day they stain the worlds around them with their element. Then the survivors fuse into the Pentarch above the black hole. Every Elemental we slay before the fusion is missing from the Pentarch, so hunt them early.
Commander, our alliance has seized the Super Cube! Every minute we hold it earns glory. Reinforce the garrison before the others strike back.
Commander, we have lost the Super Cube! Another alliance has taken it from us. Rally our allies and take it back.
Commander, our alliance has been crowned the holder of the Super Cube! Claim your rewards on the Events page.
